description: This file defines the main application entry point for a WatchOS app using SwiftUI. It sets up the main app structure, initializes data stores and communication receivers, and manages the UI scene with a WatchInboxView that handles user actions and communication with a paired device.

classes.name: OpenClawWatchApp
classes.description: Main application struct conforming to SwiftUI's App protocol, responsible for setting up the primary scene and coordinating state and communication for the WatchOS app.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main scene of the app, displaying WatchInboxView and managing the receiver's lifecycle, including sending replies and activating the receiver.
